abilities.name: Confounding Flash
abilities.desc: Confuses up to 5 enemies within 8 yds for 3 sec. Any damage taken will break the effect.

abilities.name: Contingency Plan
abilities.desc: Place a Holy ward on an ally for 30 sec. The next time this ally takes damage dropping their Health below 35%, they will gain a shield absorbing 926 damage and begin healing for 670 Health over 15 sec. A target may be affected by only one Contingency Plan.

abilities.name: Dispel Magic
abilities.desc: Dispels magic on the target, removing 2 harmful spells from a friend or 2 beneficial spells from an enemy.

abilities.name: Divine Spirit
abilities.desc: Holy power infuses the target, increasing their Spirit by 40 for 1 hour.

abilities.name: Elune's Grace
abilities.desc: Reduces the chance you'll be hit by melee and ranged attacks by 50% for 15 sec or until you are missed 3 times.

abilities.name: Feedback
abilities.desc: The priest becomes surrounded with anti-magic energy. Any successful spell cast against the priest will burn 105 of the attacker's Mana, causing 1 Shadow damage for each point of Mana burned. Lasts 15 sec.

abilities.name: Inner Fire
abilities.desc: A burst of Holy energy fills the caster, increasing armor by 1,395. Each melee or ranged damage hit against the priest will remove one charge. Lasts 10 min or until 20 charges are used.

abilities.name: Inner Focus
abilities.desc: When activated, reduces the Mana cost of your next spell by 100% and increases its critical effect chance by 25% if it is a non-periodic spell and capable of a critical effect.

abilities.name: Levitate
abilities.desc: Allows the caster to levitate, floating a few feet above the ground. While levitating, you will fall at a reduced speed and travel over water-like surfaces. Mounting or any damage taken will cancel the effect. Lasts 2 min.

abilities.name: Mana Burn
abilities.desc: Drains 746 to 788 mana from a target. For each mana drained in this way, the target takes 0.5 Shadow damage.

abilities.name: Penance
abilities.desc: Launches a volley of holy light at the target, causing 92 Holy damage to an enemy, or 425 healing to an ally, instantly and every 1 sec for 2 sec.

abilities.name: Power Infusion
abilities.desc: Infuses the target with power, increasing their spell damage and healing done by 20% for 15 sec.

abilities.name: Power Word: Fortitude
abilities.desc: Power infuses the target, increasing their Stamina by 70 for 1 hour.

abilities.name: Power Word: Shield
abilities.desc: Draws on the soul of the party member to shield them, absorbing 928 damage. Lasts 30 sec. While the shield holds, spellcasting will not be interrupted by damage. Once shielded, the target cannot be shielded again for 15 sec.

abilities.name: Prayer of Fortitude
abilities.desc: Power infuses all party and raid members, increasing their Stamina by 70 for 1 hour.

abilities.name: Prayer of Spirit
abilities.desc: Power infuses all party and raid members, increasing their Spirit by 40 for 1 hour.

abilities.name: Shackle Undead
abilities.desc: Shackles the target undead enemy for up to 50 sec. The shackled unit is unable to move, attack or cast spells. Any damage caused will release the target. Only one target can be shackled at a time.

abilities.name: Starshards
abilities.desc: Rains starshards down on the enemy target's head, causing 1,800 Arcane damage over 6 sec.

abilities.name: Abolish Disease
abilities.desc: Attempts to cure 1 disease effect on the target, and 1 more disease effect every 5 seconds for 20 sec.

abilities.name: Binding Heal
abilities.desc: Heal yourself and a friendly target for 773 to 909. This causes low threat.

abilities.name: Chastise
abilities.desc: Chastise the target, causing 272 to 306 Holy damage and Immobilizing them for up to 2 sec. Only works against Humanoids. This spell causes very low threat.

abilities.name: Cure Disease
abilities.desc: Removes 1 disease from the friendly target.

abilities.name: Desperate Prayer
abilities.desc: Instantly heals the caster for 1,285 to 1,513.

abilities.name: Divine Grace
abilities.desc: Instantly heals a friendly target below 50% Health for 1,285 to 1,513 and removes Weakened Soul from that target. Cannot be cast on self.

abilities.name: Fear Ward
abilities.desc: Wards the friendly target against Fear. The next Fear effect used against the target will fail, using up the ward. Lasts 3 min.

abilities.name: Flash Heal
abilities.desc: Heals a friendly target for 773 to 909.

abilities.name: Greater Heal
abilities.desc: A slow casting spell that heals a single target for 1,853 to 2,067.

abilities.name: Heal
abilities.desc: Heal your target for 633 to 713.

abilities.name: Holy Fire
abilities.desc: Consumes the enemy in holy flames that cause 184 to 232 Holy damage and an additional 75 Holy damage over 10 sec.

abilities.name: Holy Nova
abilities.desc:
Causes an explosion of holy light around the caster, causing 174 to 200 Holy damage to all enemy targets within 10 yards and healing all party members within 10 yards for 288 to 334. These effects cause no threat.

Each time Holy Fire deals damage, you have a 5% chance for your next Holy Nova to cost no Mana.

abilities.name: Lesser Heal
abilities.desc: Heal your target for 157 to 181.

abilities.name: Prayer of Healing
abilities.desc: A powerful prayer that heals the target and their party for 631 to 667. Party members must be within 40 yards of target.

abilities.name: Prayer of Mending
abilities.desc: Places a spell on the target that heals them for 413 the next time they take damage or receive non-periodic healing. When the heal occurs, Prayer of Mending jumps to a party or raid member within 20 yds. Jumps up to 5 times and lasts 30 sec after each jump. This spell can only be placed on one target at a time per caster.

abilities.name: Renew
abilities.desc: Heals the target of 830 damage over 15 sec.

abilities.name: Resurrection
abilities.desc: Brings a dead player back to life with 750 health and 1000 mana. Cannot be cast when in combat.

abilities.name: Smite
abilities.desc: Smite an enemy for 166 to 186 Holy damage.

abilities.name: Dark Sacrifice
abilities.desc: Cannibalize 1,600 of your own Health over 15 sec to gain 1,600 Mana, plus your Spirit.

abilities.name: Devouring Plague
abilities.desc: Afflicts the target with a disease that causes 848 Shadow damage over 24 sec. Damage caused by the Devouring Plague heals the caster.

abilities.name: Fade
abilities.desc: Fade out, discouraging enemies from attacking you for 10 sec. More effective than Fade (rank 5).

abilities.name: Hex of Weakness
abilities.desc: Weakens the target enemy, reducing melee attack power by 204 and reducing the effectiveness of any healing by 20%. Lasts 2 min

abilities.name: Mind Blast
abilities.desc: Blasts the target for 477 to 503 Shadow damage, but causes a high amount of threat.

abilities.name: Mind Control
abilities.desc: Controls a humanoid mind up to level 64, but increases the time between attacks by 25%. Lasts up to 1 min.

abilities.name: Mind Flay
abilities.desc: Assault the target's mind with Shadow energy, causing 390 Shadow damage over 3 sec and slowing their movement speed by 50%.

abilities.name: Mind Soothe
abilities.desc: Soothes the target, reducing the range at which it will attack you by 10 yards. Only affects Humanoid targets level 70 or lower. Lasts 15 sec.

abilities.name: Mind Vision
abilities.desc: Allows the caster to see through the target's eyes for 1 min. Will not work if the target is in another instance or on another continent.

abilities.name: Prayer of Shadow Protection
abilities.desc: Power infuses all party and raid members, increasing their Shadow resistance by 60 for 20 min.

abilities.name: Psychic Scream
abilities.desc: The caster lets out a psychic scream, causing 5 enemies within 8 yards to flee for 8 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect.

abilities.name: Shadow Protection
abilities.desc: Increases the target's resistance to Shadow spells by 60 for 10 min.

abilities.name: Shadow Word: Death
abilities.desc: A word of dark binding that inflicts 444 to 472 Shadow damage to the target. If your target is not killed by Shadow Word: Death, you take backlash damage equal to 10% of your maximum health.

abilities.name: Shadow Word: Pain
abilities.desc: A word of darkness that causes 762 Shadow damage over 18 sec.

abilities.name: Shadowform
abilities.desc: Assume Shadowform, increasing your Shadow damage by 10%, reducing the Mana cost of all Shadow spells by 50%, increasing the critical strike damage bonus of your Shadow spells by 100%, and reducing Physical damage taken by you by 15%. However, you may not cast healing spells while in this form.

abilities.name: Shadowguard
abilities.desc: The caster is surrounded by shadows. When a spell, melee or ranged attack hits the caster, the attacker will be struck for 96 Shadow damage. Attackers can only be damaged once every few seconds. This damage causes no threat. 3 charges. Lasts 10 min.

abilities.name: Silence
abilities.desc: Silences the target, preventing them from casting spells for 5 sec and interrupting their spellcasts for 3 sec.

abilities.name: Touch of Weakness
abilities.desc: The next melee attack on the caster will cause 56 Shadow damage and reduce the attacker's melee attack power by the attacker by 204 for 2 min.

abilities.name: Vampiric Embrace
abilities.desc: Afflicts your target with Shadow energy that causes all party members to be healed for 20% of any Shadow spell damage you deal for 30 sec.

abilities.name: Shoot
abilities.desc: Attack with an equipped wand.

abilities.name: Will of the Forsaken
abilities.desc: Instantly removes all Charm, Fear and Sleep effects.

abilities.name: Cannibalize
abilities.desc: When activated, regenerates 7% of total Health and 7% of total Mana every 2 sec for 10 sec. Only works on Humanoid or Undead corpses within 5 yds. Any movement, action, or damage taken while Cannibalizing will cancel the effect.

abilities.name: Berserking
abilities.desc: Increases your spellcasting and attack speed by 10% for 15 sec.

abilities.name: Rapid Regeneration
abilities.desc: Regenerate 50% of your maximum Health over 6 sec. Any movement, action, or damage taken will cancel the effect.

abilities.name: Perception
abilities.desc: Dramatically increases stealth detection for 20 sec.

abilities.name: Will to Survive
abilities.desc: Instantly removes all Stun effects.

abilities.name: Find Treasure
abilities.desc: Allows the dwarf to sense nearby treasure, making it appear on the minimap.  Lasts until canceled.

abilities.name: Stoneform
abilities.desc: Instantly removes and grants immunity to all Bleed, Poison, and Disease effects, and reduces all Physical damage taken by 10% for 8 sec.

abilities.name: Shadowmeld
abilities.desc: Activate to slip into the shadows, reducing the chance for enemies to detect your presence. Lasts until cancelled or upon moving. Using this ability in combat discourages enemies from attacking you, but increases the cooldown to 2 min.

abilities.name: Elune's Light
abilities.desc: Increases your critical strike chance with all spells and attacks by 10% for 15 sec.

abilities.name: Escape Artist
abilities.desc: Instantly escape the effects of any movement impairing effect and gain immunity to those effects for 3 sec.

abilities.name: Eureka!
abilities.desc: For 8 sec, your non-periodic damaging abilities cost 10% less (Mana, Rage or Energy) and deal 10% more damage. For Priests, your non-periodic damaging or healing abilities cost 10% less Mana and do 10% more damage or healing. Periodic effects get nothing from it; a channeled spell is not periodic. The Mage's own tooltip is the one that leaves out non-periodic.
